title: Exhaustion B_r ↑ B_1 for the double integral of |f(x) − f(y)|²
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let f : ℝ^n → ℝ be a.e.-strongly measurable for Lebesgue measure restricted to the open unit ball B_1, and let K ∈ [0, ∞]. If ∫⁻_{x ∈ B_r} ∫⁻_{y ∈ B_r} ‖f(x) − f(y)‖ₑ² dy dx ≤ K for every r with 0 < r < 1 (B_r = ball(0, r)), then ∫⁻_{x ∈ B_1} ∫⁻_{y ∈ B_1} ‖f(x) − f(y)‖ₑ² dy dx ≤ K.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : Rn n → ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0∞), AEStronglyMeasurable f (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Rn n) 1)) → (∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < 1 → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) r, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ K) → ∫⁻ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∫⁻ y in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖f x - f y‖ₑ ^ 2 ≤ K
